messages:
leah: FYI CFO at MeridianLabs escalated the POC to execs. They want a one-page packet by Fri noon listing blockers + owners + mitigations. asks: Okta test tenant, completed security questionnaire, BYO-KMS integration details (attestation vs key-wrap), and a pilot price estimate. also asked about data residency for eu-central.

omar: copying. i'll own the pricing slide. can someone confirm expected concurrency/token rates?

jin: i'll take the security questionnaire. which version did they send? link?

leah: it's in the deal binder: https://redwood.internal/deals/meridian/sec-q-v1.docx. note they flagged GDPR + eu residency.

alexa: KMS/crypto here. short answer: we support envelope key-wrap with BYO-KMS (fast) and full HSM attestation path (requires vendor paperwork ~3-5 weeks). i'll add our recommended interim pattern.

compliance-bot: Compliance note: For EU residency, we can provision resources in eu-central; legal review required for cross-border telemetry. Initiated intake COM-7890.

omar: Pricing ballpark (draft): 3-week pilot reserved pool (2x A5000 equiv): $29k/mo reserved prorated, overage $0.00075/token, EU isolation premium +$5k/mo. will refine after concurrency.

jin: I'll start filling the questionnaire tonight. I'll need a short network diagram and SOC2 evidence. security-bot, can you attach SOC2 link?

compliance-bot: Attached SOC2 mapping: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-2025-summary.pdf. Pen-test report link: https://redwood.internal/reports/pentest-2025.pdf.

alexa: KMS snippet for the doc: 
```
BYO-KMS (key-wrap):
1. Customer KMS holds DEK
2. DEK wrapped by RW envelope key
3. RW stores wrapped DEK, never sees plaintext

HSM path: requires attestation and vendor paperwork (3-5w).
```
Also recommending a proxy-mode fallback for pilot if attestation requested.

leah: infra, can you provision an Okta test tenant? Meridian wants SCIM group sync and a SAML assertion example.

infra-oncall: Ticket created ML-9001: Okta test tenant for MeridianLabs. Assigned infra-oncall. ETA 24h. Please add Okta admin contact to the ticket.

jin: adding SCIM sample for the questionnaire answers:
```
scim:
  group_mapping:
    research: meridian_research
    dev: meridian_dev
```

omar: timeline proposal for the packet:
- Today evening: questionnaire first pass + KMS note
- Tomorrow AM: pricing final + infra ticket confirmed
- Fri noon: send consolidated packet to CFO + CTO
If any blocker slips, escalate to execs Fri AM.

jin: action items:
- jin: sec questionnaire draft (due today 19:00 PT)
- alexa: KMS note + attestation caveats (due tomorrow 09:00 PT)
- omar: pricing draft (due tomorrow 09:00 PT)
- infra-oncall: Okta test tenant (ML-9001) ETA 24h
- compliance-bot/legal: eu residency note (COM-7890)

leah: thanks all. keep updates here and ping @leah for any immediate exec escalations. :thumbsup:
